countries.name: Botswana
countries.summary: Botswana is a landlocked country in Southern Africa with Gaborone as its capital and a growing university and health-training system. The University of Botswana delivers medicine within the national public university sector.
countries.whyStudentsChooseIt: Students can evaluate Botswana for an English-medium medical degree at the country's flagship public university. The programme offers a defined science-entry route and clinical learning within Botswana's health system.
countries.climate: Botswana has a semi-arid climate with hot summers, a seasonal rainy period and cooler, dry winters. Temperatures and rainfall vary between the summer and winter study periods.

universities.name: University of Botswana
universities.summary: The University of Botswana Faculty of Medicine and Health Sciences offers a five-year Bachelor of Medicine Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS) in Gaborone. Its verified August 2026 call sets out science-based entry routes, a competitive shortlist and further selection process. The 2026/27 University fee schedule lists BWP 78,735 per year for MBBS, including academic excursions.
universities.campusLifestyle: Medicine is delivered through the University of Botswana Faculty of Medicine and Health Sciences in Gaborone. The University publishes accommodation allocation information and a residence-management system, but the 2026/27 accommodation list makes clear that limited beds mean not every applicant receives a room.
universities.cityProfile: Gaborone is the programme location. The University publishes an annual undergraduate accommodation charge and residence process, while off-campus housing, transport, food, immigration and personal costs are separate from the MBBS fee. The 2026/27 accommodation process prioritised defined categories including international students, but a waiting-list position did not guarantee a bed.
universities.practicalExposure: The official MBBS programme page describes a five-year degree in two parts. Phase 1 covers two years of integrated basic medical sciences, problem-based learning, clinical-skills teaching and regular clinical attachments. Phase 2 covers years 3–5 and requires hospital and clinic rotations in major disciplines, community-service and public-health experience. The University describes the final year as broad patient contact through an assistant-intern scheme, with supervised skills records.
universities.hostelOverview: The 2026/27 schedule lists BWP 7,740 per year for a full-time undergraduate hostel. University accommodation is limited; the published allocation notice says unsuccessful applicants should seek housing in and around Gaborone and that a waiting-list place is not a guarantee.
universities.dietarySupport: No MBBS meal plan was identified in the reviewed University materials. Food and personal living expenses are separate from the BWP 78,735 annual MBBS fee published in the University schedule.
universities.safetyOverview: No Faculty-specific safety statistic was verified for this package. The University provides accommodation administration and campus services, while day-to-day housing, travel and personal safety planning remain separate from academic admission.
universities.studentSupport: University of Botswana publishes undergraduate admissions, online registration, payment guidance and residence-management routes. Programme-specific admissions enquiries are directed to the Faculty of Medicine and Health Sciences, while University admissions manages the central application process.

faq.question: How long is the University of Botswana MBBS?
faq.answer: The official programme page describes a five-year MBBS. Phase 1 is two years of integrated basic medical sciences and problem-based learning; Phase 2 is three years of hospital and clinic rotations.

faq.question: What is the 2026/27 MBBS fee?
faq.answer: The University of Botswana 2026/27 fee schedule lists BWP 78,735 per year for MBBS, including academic excursions. Accommodation, food, immigration, travel and personal expenses are separate.

faq.question: Does the fee include clinical-rotation costs?
faq.answer: The fee schedule says the MBBS amount includes academic excursions and separately lists MBBS rotation rentals. The published programme fee is not an all-inclusive personal cost-of-attendance budget.

faq.question: Who can apply for the August 2026 MBBS intake?
faq.answer: The call accepts qualifying Level 100 science students, eligible A-level or IB Diploma applicants, and qualifying bachelor-degree holders. Each route has stated Chemistry and additional science requirements.

faq.question: What documents are needed for the MBBS application?
faq.answer: The call lists an application-fee receipt for external applicants, passport for non-citizens, certified transcripts and certified post-school qualification evidence where applicable.

faq.question: How does selection work?
faq.answer: Applicants meeting the criteria are shortlisted and undergo a further selection process. The Faculty's programme page also describes assessment of the application form, short essay and interviews for selection.

faq.question: When does the MBBS programme start?
faq.answer: The verified August 2026 call said successful applicants would be notified by mid-July and available to begin training at the beginning of August. Future dates require a new University call.

faq.question: Is University accommodation guaranteed?
faq.answer: No. The University publishes BWP 7,740 annual undergraduate hostel fees, but its 2026/27 allocation notice states that limited beds mean not all applicants are accommodated and a waiting-list place is not guaranteed.

programmes.officialTitle: Bachelor of Medicine Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS)

fee.notes: The 2026/27 University schedule lists MBBS at BWP 78,735 per year, including academic excursions. BWP 393,675 is the annual fee multiplied by five years, not a University-published all-in package. The schedule separately lists BWP 7,740 annual undergraduate hostel accommodation and other charges.

eligibleAudiences: International and local applicants meeting the published MBBS science-entry routes
restrictions: Level 100 science route requires CGPA 3.5 with Chemistry plus two of Mathematics, Biology and Physics
A-level or IB route requires grade point 3.0 in Chemistry and two additional stated sciences
Bachelor-degree route requires at least Second-Class Upper Division and two first-year sciences
audienceEligibility.notes: The August 2026 call was open to local and international applicants.

admissionsContent.overview: The University of Botswana August 2026 MBBS call used online application and a competitive shortlist. Eligible candidates supplied certified academic and identity documents; shortlisted applicants underwent a further selection process.

eligibility.intro: MBBS applicants enter through specified Level 100 science, A-level or IB, or qualifying bachelor-degree routes with Chemistry and additional science preparation.
items: Level 100 science study with CGPA 3.5 and the stated Chemistry-plus-science combination
A-level or IB Diploma route with minimum grade point 3.0 in the stated science combination
Qualifying bachelor degree with Second-Class Upper Division and two first-year sciences
Local or international status meeting the University application requirements

applicationSteps: Submit the online MBBS application during the published call
Upload certified academic, identity and post-school documents where applicable
Include the fully paid external-applicant application-fee receipt where required
Complete the Faculty's further selection process if shortlisted
Accept the result and be available for the published August start

application: Passport for non-citizens or Omang for citizens

admissionsContent.deadlinesNote: For August 2026, applications closed 30 June 2026; successful applicants were to be notified by mid-July and begin training at the beginning of August. Future dates require a new call.
visaConsiderations: International applicants use a passport for the application and should plan immigration documentation after an offer under the rules applicable to their nationality.

programmes.medium: English; the official programme and admissions materials reviewed are published in English, while a separate language-policy statement was not identified.
programmes.feeNotes: Confirmed 2026/27 MBBS fee is BWP 78,735 per year including academic excursions. It is separate from accommodation, living and personal costs.

teachingPhases.details: Two years of integrated basic medical sciences within clinical PBL cases, clinical-skills teaching, regular clinical attachments, laboratories and community-focused learning.

Three years of hospital and clinic rotations in major disciplines, with community-service and public-health experience. The final year uses an assistant-intern scheme and supervised patient-contact skills records.

The August 2026 call sets Level 100 science, A-level or IB, and bachelor-degree MBBS routes, each with stated Chemistry and additional science requirements.
